title: Hilbert's Infinite Hotel
tagline: Every room is full. A new guest arrives. No problem. Then a bus pulls up with infinitely many more.
description: David Hilbert's hotel has infinitely many rooms and no vacancies, yet it can always take more guests. Check in a new guest, unload an infinite bus, and find the one bus that will never fit.
keywords: Hilbert's paradox of the Grand Hotel
coverAlt: A cartoon hotel with a row of doors and an infinity sign on its sign
